department: Natural Sciences Ph.D. Program (School of Graduate Studies): Physics

deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026 for fullest consideration.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for this program is December 15 for fullest consideration.

gre_subject.value: The Physics Subject Test is optional.
gre_subject.quote: Physics Subject Test: This exam is no longer required. It is now optional.

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly advised to contact the program coordinator before applying.
supervisor.quote: It is strongly recommended that applicants reach out to the program coordinator prior to applying.

funding.value: The page says assistantships may be available but does not say most students are funded.

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether applicants come directly from a bachelor's degree.

gre_general.value: The General GRE is optional for physics applicants.
gre_general.quote: GRE General Test: This exam is no longer required. It is now optional.

toefl_min.value: The physics department asks for TOEFL iBT 80 out of 120, which is above the school minimum.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL: Greater than or equal to 80/120 or IELTS: Greater than or equal to 5.5

ielts_min.value: The physics department asks for IELTS 5.5 as an alternative to TOEFL.
ielts_min.quote: TOEFL: Greater than or equal to 80/120 or IELTS: Greater than or equal to 5.5

english_waiver.value: Physics applicants with a bachelor's or master's degree from India do not need an English test.
english_waiver.quote: Master's and PhD students who earned a bachelor's or master's degree from an institution in Bangladesh, Egypt, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka and Turkey are not required to submit proof of English proficiency for admission to these programs.

notes: Physics discipline of the Natural Sciences PhD. Department asks for TOEFL 80/120 or IELTS 5.5 instead of the school minimums.
